notes.title: "Cellveillance" is now officially released! Enjoy a 22% discount!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The development team of “Cellveillance” sends our warmest greetings and sincerest wishes to you all!

Thank you for your attention and support—“Cellveillance”is now officially released as of June 5, 2025! For the first two weeks, enjoy a 22% discount (78% of the original price), with additional savings on bundle purchases. This offer lasts until June 19, so grab it early to participate in exclusive merchandise events! Join our official communities for real-time updates:

QQ Group 1: 173503067

Collect Animal Cards for Merchandise!
🔗 Event details: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3218580/view/498323476114833827
🔗 Card trading guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3357659458
🔗 Mobile Authenticator guide: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3218580/view/498322216088241493

About “Cellveillance”
“Cellveillance” is a detective narrative game where you play as an apartment supervisor tasked with daily patrols and managing all affairs within the building. A mysterious organization demands intel on the tenants—but this seemingly ordinary apartment hides darker secrets beneath its peaceful facade.

You came here to repay a debt, but when staring into the abyss becomes your duty, how will you choose? Every zoom-in click challenges your definition of justice; every camera angle reveals an urban Rashomon that defies expectations. Remember: Appearances can deceive.
